essence: The recitation proceeds by uttering rañjanīṃ and klīṃ in that order.
Forty letters are to be recited in order at this point.
The mantra is declared to contain ninety-eight letters.
The mantra is difficult for the meritless but has been served by great sages and others.
The elements previously declared for this mantra indeed apply.
